'0' is accepted (no positive check)
rationale: none stated in code beyond per-chain defaults

Validation belongs to the DB slice (chainRegistry.ts); recorded here because the buy path consumes it.

name: Snipe buy slippage percent (V2 and V3)
comparison: minOut = expectedOut - expectedOut * BigInt(slippage) / 100n; the router reverts if the output is below minOut
representation: number converted with BigInt(); BigInt throws RangeError on a fractional value
effective_unset: n/a: hard-coded, not read from the environment
effective_empty: n/a: hard-coded, not read from the environment
effective_non_numeric: n/a (constant). If the constant were 0, `|| 5` would silently make it 5; a fractional constant would throw into the catch and leave minOut = 0 (fail open, AUD-BUY-003)
recommendation: Hold slippage as integer basis points (bigint math) so no value can throw into the fail-open catch, and decide the quote-failure behaviour on OD-15.

effective_unset: the defaults above
effective_empty: '' -> default (|| in the parse)
effective_non_numeric: 'abc' -> NaN: Date.now() - last < NaN is false, so the cooldown never blocks; count >= NaN and total + amount > NaN are false too, so a malformed MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS or MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE silently disables that limit (fail open)
rationale: none stated in riskManager.ts beyond defaults

recommendation: Validate the risk env values at load (fail loud as the tax bps do) and reserve the cooldown and budget at canSnipe time (card BUY-03). riskManager.ts belongs to the DB slice (22-21); recorded here because the buy path consumes it.
